text: A sixty-two year old man presented with progressive dyspnoea and bilateral lower limb oedema over three weeks, with a history of hypertension and type two diabetes, and examination revealed raised jugular venous pressure and fine bibasal crepitations on auscultation of the chest.
An unrelated case of a young woman with an acute migraine responding to triptans.
A paediatric patient with a febrile seizure and full recovery after supportive care at home.
